en: Vimānavatthu: The Chapter on the Woman’s Mansion,
Section on the Seats (Pīṭhavagga)
10. The Mansion Story of the Alms Offering of Sesame Seeds “O deity, you who stand there with such surpassing beauty;”
Illuminating all directions like a star among the herbs,
by what cause do you possess such a complexion?
By what means do you succeed here?
For all those riches that are dear to the mind arise for you.
I ask you, O goddess of great majesty:
when you were a human being, what merit did you perform?
By what means have you come to possess such blazing power?
"And your radiance shines in all directions.
That deity, being asked by Moggallāna, was uplifted in mind.
When questioned, she answered:
"This is the fruit of that deed.
When I was among humans, having become a human being..."
In a previous birth in the human world,
I saw the stainless Buddha,
serene and undisturbed.
I gave a gift by force,
an unwilling offering of sesame seeds to the Buddha, who is worthy of offerings.
With my own hands, full of faith, I offered them.
Because of that, such is my complexion;
because of that, I am successful here.
And riches arise for me,
whatever is dear to the mind.
I declare this to you, O monk of great power.
“Having been born as humans, I performed meritorious deeds;
therefore, my majestic power blazes forth in this way,
and my complexion illuminates all directions.”
The Tiladakkhiṇa Vimāna is the tenth.
